9f43a8b4140af3192aee928c9f380768b59e1455.sourceText: 这就是下坡尤其要看的地方：正常坡的较低侧，可能只是低于这一小片的代表地面，并不是真正的坑。反过来，真正坑洼只有被雷达看到且留下有效回波，才可能通过这个高度差表现出来；没有回波的断崖不因此自动得到可靠识别。扩展节点也没有近场那种 `noDataObstacle` 合成障碍功能，没有点的区域如何影响规划，还取决于下游的未知区域设置。
9f43a8b4140af3192aee928c9f380768b59e1455.translatedText: This is especially what to look at on a downhill slope: the lower side of a normal slope may simply be the representative ground lower than this small patch, and is not a true pit\. Conversely, a true depression can be represented through this height difference only if it is seen by radar and leaves a valid echo; a cliff with no echo does not automatically become reliably identified because of this\. The expansion node also does not have the near\-field `noDataObstacle` synthetic obstacle function; how areas without points affect planning still depends on the downstream unknown\-area settings\.
